summary: Tested 3 new features: live header search, wishlist (localStorage), inventory sync on checkout. 5 new pytest backend tests added (search match/no-match/case-insensitive, stock decrement, insufficient-stock 400) all pass. Full backend_test.py suite remains green. Frontend Playwright E2E verified: typing 'parka' debounce-navigates to /catalog?search=parka (1 card, Obsidian Field Parka), clear-search-btn restores full catalog (8 cards); wishlist-toggle updates nav badge to 1, /wishlist page shows item, persists across hard reload, unsetting shows empty-state; complete 3-step simulated checkout decreased stock_status from 10 to 9 units on product detail page.
action_items: Spec/implementation testid naming drift: review_request lists ProductDetail add-to-cart as `add-to-cart-btn` but the actual testid in ProductDetail.jsx line 188 is `add-to-cart-button`. Catalog ProductCard uses `add-to-cart-btn-<id>`. Consider unifying or documenting the two conventions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/orders: stock validation and $inc decrement are not transactional. Under concurrent high load two orders could both pass the stock>=qty check and oversell. Acceptable for simulated checkout but flag for prod — use conditional update {$inc:{stock:-qty}} with filter {stock:{$gte:qty}} and verify modified_count==1, otherwise rollback.
WishlistContext is localStorage-only with no server sync — intentional per spec, but note cross-device/logged-in users will not see their wishlist on another browser.

Header live-search debounce fires navigation on every keystroke change (>=2 chars); works, but each navigation pushes a new history entry — consider replace() instead of push() to avoid polluting browser back-stack.
Catalog search banner + clear-search-btn correctly reset URL params; good UX.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@telluricgaia.com / TelluricAdmin#2026 (not needed for these 3 flows — guest checkout + localStorage wishlist).
seed_data_creation: Several guest test orders created during E2E; one product stock was decremented by 1 (10->9) and the first product by 2 (via backend pytest). Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct testids: Header=header-search-input; Catalog=catalog-search-banner + clear-search-btn + product-card-<id>; ProductCard wishlist=wishlist-toggle-<id>; ProductDetail wishlist=product-wishlist-btn; ProductDetail ADD TO CART=add-to-cart-button (NOT add-to-cart-btn); CartDrawer checkout=cart-checkout-btn; Checkout step buttons=checkout-to-delivery, checkout-to-payment, place-order-btn; stock=stock-status; wishlist nav badge=wishlist-count-badge. CartDrawer opens automatically after add-to-cart (do not click nav-cart-button right after ATC).
rca of the issue: No defects. Only had to correct one testid mismatch in test script (add-to-cart-button vs add-to-cart-btn) and align with existing checkout testids (cart-checkout-btn, checkout-to-delivery, checkout-to-payment).
